BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   B. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   C. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   D. Treat Money as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Journals Page 14 of 55 1 STRAND 1.0: BUSINESS AND MONEY MAN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Books of Original Entry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Money and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Business Goals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
